svg.title: Mermaid 架构图：08-skill-evaluation
svg.desc: 基于当前 Python 实现的 Skevo 系统设计图。
svg.title: Skill 评测、候选比较与 Champion 晋升
svg.desc: 五个阶段依次展示评测入口与稳定 lineage、replay 去重冻结与分片、当前 active 基线规则和 lifecycle 状态、可选 variants 的 mutate dev 选择与 promotion test 隔离，以及仅在 write artifacts 开启后执行的 dev pre-gate、promotion candidate 选择、Champion gate 和非事务产物写入；所有写入异常汇入同一个向上抛出的失败终点

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: D · variants、mutate_dev 选择与 promotion_test 隔离

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: C · current_active 规则评测与 lifecycle status

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: B · replay pool、冻结与稳定 split

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: A · 入口、输入与稳定 lineage

color: rgb(59, 42, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
👤 /skill-eval 或 Python API
REPL 写入默认开启，当前无 dry-run CLI
API 可传 side_query = None
或 write_artifacts = False

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
输入来源
provenance log / index
usage / lifecycle stats
active Skill snapshots

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
Skill 名并集仅来自
active snapshots + provenance index keys
+ usage keys + lifecycle keys
原始 log 只供 aggregate / replay rows
log-only Skill 不会仅凭 log 进入评测

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
稳定 lineage ID
仅对去首尾空白的 Skill name 做 SHA-1
skill-<16 hex>

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
构建 replay pool
仅取非空 user / assistant messages 且必须有 user
ID = hash(skill + messages + latest user)
log 与 index source 按 ID 去重

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
💾 合并既有 replay_pool.jsonl
同 ID 更新，全量重排并重新 split
成功后覆写 frozen dataset

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
仅对当前来源内存分片
不读取或写入 frozen dataset

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
split 默认规则
< 2 条：全部 mutate_dev，无 test
≥ 2 条：hash 约 75 / 25
并强制 dev / test 各至少 1 条

div.style: color: rgb(50, 24, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
编译最多 8 条规则
始终含 hard non-empty；再按 Skill 文本加入
引用 / 段数 / JSON 等 programmatic rules
有 side_query 才加入 LLM binary rules

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
⚙ current_active 基线
在全部 replay 的历史 latest assistant 上判定
LLM judge 异常按 fail 记录

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
lifecycle gate
默认值；Python API 可覆盖
replay ≥ 2，test ≥ 1，retrieved ≥ 5
pass ≥ .80，relevance ≥ .35，used ≥ .20

div.style: color: rgb(50, 24, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
固定判定顺序
pruned → unobserved → incubating
数量 gate 通过后：test hard failures > 0
或任一 hard failure > 0，或 pass / relevance / used
未达阈值 → watch；否则 healthy

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center;

span.p:
side_query 可用
且 replay 非空?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
candidate_bundle = {}
无 variants、dev winner 或 test summary

div.style: color: rgb(7, 59, 76) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
◇ 生成候选
失败规则 → heuristic guards
无失败 → 最多 2 条 non-programmatic rules
有真实失败才尝试 LLM mutation
失败 mutation 忽略；按 instructions 去重，最多 4 个

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
⚙ 仅在 mutate_dev 生成并评估全部 variants
生成异常转 candidate_response_failed 文本
按 average score 降序、hard failures 升序

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;
color: rgb(50, 24, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
⚙ 仅对 dev winner
在 promotion_test 重新生成与评估

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
输出 candidate_bundle
best_dev_summary 始终来自 dev
best_test_summary 仅在有 test 时存在
此阶段尚未选择 promotion candidate

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;
color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
💾 按序写成功
eval_spec.json → outputs.jsonl → judgments.jsonl
包含 current_active 与可用 variant 结果

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
bundle 同时有 best variant 与 test summary
且 best_dev score ≥ current 全 replay score + .01
且 hard failures 不增加?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
仅在此选择 promotion candidate
dev pre-gate 失败：current snapshot + 全 replay summary
通过：winner snapshot + promotion_test summary

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
读取 lineage Champion
随后调用 _promotion_decision

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(58, 38, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
非 healthy 结果
unobserved / incubating / pruned：保留原 status
watch：rejected

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;
color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
candidate score ≥ Champion + .01
且 hard failures 不增加?

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(50, 24, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;
color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
💾 仅晋升时按序写成功
champions.json registry → champion.json
→ 独立 champion SKILL.md
不会覆盖 active Skill

div.style: color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
💾 所有 status 均写成功
run summary.json

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
💾 全部 Skills 完成后写成功
online_eval_report.json

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p: 返回 report / 格式化终端输出

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 150px; text-align: center; width: 150px;

span.p:
⚠ 写入异常向上抛出
写入非事务且无统一保护
可能留下部分产物

svg.text: Skill 评测、候选比较与 Champion 晋升
